description: Phase D + Phase 6 — section fade combined: a single break boundary at frame 60 has clip A ending and clip B starting. fadeSeconds=0.5 (15 frames at 30fps). Track 0 holds clip A: starts at frame 0, duration=60, ends at 60 (post-end fade-out window [60, 75)). Track 1 holds clip B: starts at frame 60 (position=2_000_000us at 30fps), duration=60 (fade-in window [60, 75)). At frame 65, both clips in their respective fade windows: A multiplier = 1 - 5/15 = 10/15 ~= 0.667 (held tail), B multiplier = 5/15 ~= 0.333 (fade-in). At frame 60 (the break boundary), A is at start of held tail -> 1.0, B at start of fade-in -> 0.0. At frame 75 both windows close: A is no longer active (past the tail), B is at full alpha 1.0.
